cue.zhTW: 手肘貼住墊臂，以背闊肌帶動機械臂由頭頂向下拉至軀幹前。
cue.en: Keep the elbows on the pads and drive the lever down from overhead using the lats.

cue.zhTW: 固定骨盆與雙腿，以軀幹旋轉帶動機械，控制去程與回程。
cue.en: Keep the hips and legs fixed, rotate through the trunk, and control both directions.

name.zhTW: 單臂過頭滑輪三頭肌伸展
反握 EZ 槓滑輪彎舉
交叉滑輪 Y 字上舉
坐姿滑輪中斜方肌聳肩

cue.zhTW: 雙腳墊高，身體保持一直線，胸口下降後推回起始位置。
cue.en: Elevate the feet, keep a straight body line, lower the chest, and press back up.

cue.zhTW: 俯臥於約 45 度上斜椅，讓手臂自然下垂並固定上臂完成彎舉。
cue.en: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, keep the upper arms still, and curl with control.

cue.zhTW: 滑輪設在低位，手肘微彎，將手臂側抬至肩高後控制回放。
cue.en: Set the pulley low, keep a soft elbow, raise to shoulder height, and lower under control.

cue.zhTW: 雙手撐在上斜椅，手肘保持伸直，讓肩胛骨前伸與後收。
cue.en: Keep the elbows straight on an elevated surface and move only through protraction and retraction of the shoulder blades.

cue.zhTW: 雙手撐在穩固高台，身體保持一直線，胸口靠近高台後推回。
cue.en: Keep a straight body line, lower the chest toward a stable elevated surface, then press away.

cue.zhTW: 調整座椅使握把對齊胸部，肩胛穩定後向前推並控制回放。
cue.en: Align the handles with the chest, keep the shoulder blades stable, and control the press and return.

cue.zhTW: 雙臂伸直支撐身體，膝蓋收向胸口並維持軀幹穩定。
cue.en: Support on straight arms, draw the knees toward the chest, and hold the trunk steady.

cue.zhTW: 側身以前臂支撐，上側腿放在椅面，抬起骨盆並維持身體一直線。
cue.en: Support the top leg on a bench, lift the hips, and maintain a straight side-plank position.

cue.zhTW: 上側腿放在椅面，以前臂撐起身體，維持骨盆與軀幹穩定。
cue.en: Place the top leg on a bench and hold a stable side plank with the hips lifted.

cue.zhTW: 固定腳踝並保持髖部伸直，以腿後側控制身體下降與抬起。
cue.en: Anchor the ankles, keep the hips extended, and use the hamstrings to control the body.

cue.zhTW: 俯臥在長椅上固定上半身，以臀肌帶動雙腿抬至身體延長線。
cue.en: Brace the upper body on a bench and lift the legs with the glutes to body level.

cue.zhTW: 將一側腳踝放在對側大腿上，保持背部延伸並由髖部微微前傾。
cue.en: Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh and hinge forward gently from the hips.

cue.zhTW: 雙肘放在椅面，臀部向後移並讓胸口下沉，伸展背闊肌與肩部。
cue.en: Rest the elbows on a bench, sit the hips back, and lower the chest to stretch the lats and shoulders.

cue.zhTW: 跪在長椅前，雙肘放在椅面並讓胸口向下沉，保持腰椎穩定。
cue.en: Kneel before a bench, place the elbows on it, and sink the chest while keeping the low back controlled.

cue.zhTW: 調整座椅與靠背，沿機械軌跡斜上推舉並控制回放。
cue.en: Set the seat and back pad, press upward along the machine path, and return under control.

cue.zhTW: 仰躺在上斜椅，固定上臂，以手肘屈伸控制啞鈴下降與推回。
cue.en: Lie on an incline bench, keep the upper arms still, and control the dumbbells through elbow flexion and extension.

cue.zhTW: 單手支撐並使用較重啞鈴，軀幹維持穩定，將啞鈴拉向髖部。
cue.en: Brace with one arm, keep the trunk controlled, and row a heavy dumbbell toward the hip.

cue.zhTW: 使用三角握把，挺胸保持軀幹穩定，將握把拉向腹部後控制回放。
cue.en: Use a triangle handle, keep the torso stable, pull toward the abdomen, and return under control.

name.zhTW: 坐姿反握窄握滑輪划船

cue.zhTW: 採反握窄握，挺胸並將握把拉向下腹，避免軀幹過度後仰。
cue.en: Use a close supinated grip, row toward the lower abdomen, and avoid excessive torso lean.

cue.zhTW: 單手持啞鈴向側邊跨步，髖部向後下沉，再由支撐腳推回。
cue.en: Hold a dumbbell, step laterally, sit the hips back, and drive through the working leg to return.

cue.zhTW: 雙手握住槓片，手肘微彎，抬至肩高後控制下降。
cue.en: Hold one weight plate with both hands, keep a soft elbow, raise to shoulder height, and lower under control.

cue.zhTW: 啞鈴置於肩上，微屈膝髖後快速伸展下肢，借力將啞鈴推至頭頂。
cue.en: Dip through the knees and hips, then drive the dumbbells overhead with coordinated leg power.

name.zhTW: 高角度上斜史密斯胸推
低角度上斜史密斯胸推

cue.zhTW: 坐在滑輪下拉機，雙手窄握把手，將把手拉向上胸。
cue.en: Sit at the pulldown machine, use a close grip, and pull the handle toward the upper chest.

cue.zhTW: 坐在滑輪下拉機，雙手寬握橫桿，將橫桿拉向上胸。
cue.en: Sit at the pulldown machine, use a wide grip, and pull the bar toward the upper chest.

cue.zhTW: 坐姿將啞鈴從肩膀推至頭頂。
cue.en: From a seated position, press dumbbells from the shoulders overhead.

name.zhTW: 俯臥啞鈴划船與坐姿聳肩
name.en: Lying Dumbbell Row SS Seated Shrug

cue.zhTW: 以超級組方式完成俯臥啞鈴划船與坐姿啞鈴聳肩。
cue.en: Perform a superset of lying dumbbell rows and seated dumbbell shrugs.

cue.zhTW: 俯臥在長凳上，將啞鈴向肋骨方向划起。
cue.en: Lie face down on a bench and row dumbbells toward the ribs.

cue.zhTW: 以寬握將槓鈴從地面拉至頭頂鎖定。
cue.en: Use a wide grip to pull the barbell from the floor to an overhead lockout.

cue.zhTW: 從地面將槓鈴拉起，接到肩前架位。
cue.en: Pull the barbell from the floor and catch it in the front rack position.

cue.zhTW: 以快速而穩定的節奏完成槓鈴硬舉。
cue.en: Perform a fast, controlled barbell deadlift.
